findings.basis: Replacement term cancels under equalR, joint convexity plus DPI, d1 handled separately, active support and CQ reduction.

findings.claim: Proper-support restricted inverse identities with row-weight-independent norm.
findings.basis: Gram positive for m<n; v=BG^-1 1 solvesTv=z; norm m(n-1)/(n-m) has no minimum weight. Full support excluded.

findings.claim: Unique minimum eigenvalue and exact Schur/root bounds.
findings.basis: H0 positive, H(epsilon t) negative, derivative<-1, interlacing and commuting positive functions ofT. Valid for epsilon=beta delta; not arbitrary regularization.

findings.claim: Binary readout with all three divergences tending to log2 uniformly in zero-Doeblin K at fixedn.
findings.basis: Full normalized probabilities, correct plus||minus orientation, sumt=n, uniform p/qbounds, Bernoulli monotonicity and DPI squeeze. Effects vary withK,k; preparation independentK.

findings.claim: Certified asymmetric separations and limits of selector, regularizer and positive-d extrapolations.
findings.basis: TVDobrushin3/4; reproduced interval lower bounds at64/128. Wrong max-overlap branch, regularizer cases and flagged-background failure retained. Binary exactcoefficient1/2 differs from1-d7/10.

findings.claim: Universal harmonic upper and named five sharp symmetric coefficients.
findings.basis: Full complex HS inverse forms, endpoints, zero twirl, faithful simplex and actual marginal, triangular Sylvester identity and ordered BKM/Umegaki limits. No all-Petz equality.

findings.claim: Binary-input equality and classical benchmark separation.
findings.basis: Whitening gives functions of same X; active rows/zero entries and boundary suprema checked. Classical two-support reduction prior; binary hypotheses/input/output distinct.

findings.claim: Faithful phase family, measured finite formula, fixed-n and fixed-z limits.
findings.basis: Normalizations, common actualr, full complement and input denominator correct. Ordered scales and conditional costs preserved; inactive n2mode absent.

findings.claim: Nonprimitive amplified fixed-point channel and one/two-step distinction.
findings.basis: Fixed algebra spectrum, H3(1/4)=1/10, variable commonE and comparator; no contradiction to fixed faithful comparator or historical-priority claim.
